title: Secrets of Strixhaven Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven stands, whose history the archaics experience.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A student who calmed the Dawning Archaic with the help of others.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An archaic that Lluwen, with help, calmed.

entities.name: Augusta
entities.description: A dean of Strixhaven who cast a fail-safe spell that activated upon her death.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: The Oracle of Arcavios, who speaks of the archaics and the world's many remakings.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A Quandrix second-year student.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A character Tam speaks to about a blocked path.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: A Strixhaven college.

entities.name: Nev
entities.description: A Strixhaven dean who speaks of the archaics' endurance.

entities.name: Adrix
entities.description: A Strixhaven dean who studies nature's patterns to protect Strixhaven's future.

entities.name: Moseo
entities.description: A Strixhaven dean who shucked his flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection.

entities.name: Embrose
entities.description: A Strixhaven dean who has come to value honesty.

entities.name: Veyran
entities.description: A Strixhaven dean who finds it hard to represent just one side.

entities.name: Galazeth Prismari
entities.description: A figure of the Prismari tradition who believes the artist should suffer for their craft.

entities.name: Quintorius
entities.description: An explorer motivated to keep exploring by each new discovery.

entities.name: Willowdusk
entities.description: Whose office became an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students after the Invasion.

entities.name: the Invasion
entities.description: A calamity whose aftermath brought grief to Strixhaven students.

entities.name: the Blood Age
entities.description: A turbulent age of Arcavios that few relics survived.

entities.name: Blex
entities.description: A Witherbloom pest in whose honor students held a yearly search; he has passed.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Source of the infection that Moseo fought.

entities.name: the archaics
entities.description: Ancient beings who experience all of Arcavian history.

events.summary: Lluwen, with the help of others, calmed the Dawning Archaic.
events.quote: By himself, Lluwen couldn't have hoped to calm the Dawning Archaic

events.summary: The archaics rampaged, and worse followed.
events.quote: In the wake of the archaics' rampage, much worse was to come.

events.summary: After the Invasion, Willowdusk's office became an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.
events.quote: Willowdusk's office turned into an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.

events.summary: Moseo shucked his flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection.
events.quote: When I shucked my flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection, it was not loss to me, merely a new state of being.

events.summary: Augusta's fail-safe spell activated upon her death.
events.quote: My fail-safe spell, activated upon my death, was precaution born from tales of the careless.
